name: Remix The Authentic Sunnah
description:
Introducing "The Authentic Sunnah" — Your Complete Daily Islamic Companion (100% Free & Ad-Free)
Connect with the Quran, Sunnah, and Seerah every single day with The Authentic Sunnah—a beautifully crafted, distraction-free Islamic web app designed to help you build consistent daily worship habits and deepen your authentic Islamic knowledge in English, Urdu, and Arabic.
✨ Key Features Inside the App:
• 📖 Quran Reader with Live Hasanat & Habit Tracker: Read the Holy Quran with Sahih International (English), Urdu translations, and Tafsir Ibn Kathir. Track your daily Hasanat earned, Verses read, Pages completed, Reading Time, and Daily Streaks with custom goals you control.
• 📚 Authentic Hadith Collections: Explore major authentic collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami' at-Tirmidhi, Riyad as-Salihin, and more) in clean English and Urdu.
• 🕌 Complete Seerah (From The Sealed Nectar): Read the entire life journey of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) chapter by chapter in both English and Urdu.
• 🌟 Lives of the Companions & Four Caliphs: Detailed, structured biographies of Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (رضي الله عنهم), the Asharah Mubasharah, Mothers of the Believers, and notable Sahabah.
• 🤲 Daily Adhkar, Duas & 99 Names of Allah: Interactive digital Tasbih counters for Morning & Evening Adhkar, categorized authentic Duas, and Asma-ul-Husna with meanings.
• 🧭 Pillars of Islam, Iman & Akhirah Guide: Clear, authentic explanations of the 5 Pillars of Islam, 6 Pillars of Iman, and the Day of Judgment, plus Salah Times, Qibla Direction, and Zakah Calculator.
• 🎥 Official YouTube Lectures: Watch the latest reminders and videos from The Authentic Sunnah channel directly inside the app.
